text:
Drake Batherson was a fourth-round pick, 121st overall in 2017, and he has spent his career proving that was a miss. This fall he has 18 points in 18 games for Ottawa, split evenly at 9 goals and 9 assists, and he ran a point streak to seven games before it stopped against Buffalo. His three-goal night against the Rangers on Oct. 24 was the high point.

The goals deserve a careful read. He is shooting 22.5% on 40 shots, with 9 goals on 5.7 expected goals. He shot 20% last season too, so he may simply be a strong finisher, but that rate on that volume rarely holds for a full year. Our range puts him nearer 32 goals than the pace he is on.

The rest is steady. At five on five the Senators take about 55% of expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, and his hardest shot ranks in the 89th percentile by NHL EDGE. He has gone two games without a point. We'd watch whether the shots pick back up before the goals do.
headline: Batherson is scoring like a sniper again
